$comment: Intended visual changes, allowed only while visual-reference.sha is the reference below; see lib/approvals.ts.

changes.reason: Player titles: the profile page gains its Title section before Country (the selected title or 'No title', a pencil opening the member's titles in one select, grouped by category); profile-title-edit is a new state with a title picked, shown at once under the name. Checked: of 349 screenshots only the 24 profile states and the 9 of the new title states differ; the sample player has no title selected, so its header and every popup and Discord card without a title are pixel-identical.

New states for player titles: the selected title as a line under the name, white on the orange bar (player 5, Discord card) and black on a world champion's gold bar (player 2, popup). The reference commit has no titles, so it shows these players without the line.
